violin.name: Violin
violin.posture_rhyme: Up Like a Rocket, Down Like the Rain, Back and Forth like a choo choo train, Round and Round like the Rolling Sun, Pinky on Point, Corner on Thumb, Put it on my head and now I'm done.

viola.name: Viola
viola.posture_rhyme: Up Like a Rocket, Down Like the Rain, Back and Forth like a choo choo train, Round and Round like the Rolling Sun, Pinky on Point, Corner on Thumb, Put it on my head and now I'm done.

cello.name: Cello
cello.posture_rhyme: Sit on the edge of your seat, feet flat on the floor, hug the cello like a bear!

double_bass.name: Double Bass
double_bass.posture_rhyme: Stand up tall, feet shoulder width apart, let the bass lean into you.

electric_bass.name: Electric Bass
electric_bass.posture_rhyme: Strap securely, stand up straight, keep your wrists relaxed.

clarinet.name: Clarinet
clarinet.posture_rhyme: Sit up straight, feet flat on the floor, instrument up and out from your body.

flute.name: Flute
flute.posture_rhyme: Sit up straight, feet flat on the floor, hold it parallel to the ground.

saxophone.name: Saxophone
saxophone.posture_rhyme: Sit up straight, feet flat on the floor, neck strap adjusted so the mouthpiece comes to you.

trumpet.name: Trumpet
trumpet.posture_rhyme: Sit up straight, feet flat on the floor, bell pointing straight ahead.

trombone.name: Trombone
trombone.posture_rhyme: Sit up straight, feet flat on the floor, keep your slide arm relaxed.

french_horn.name: French Horn
french_horn.posture_rhyme: Sit up straight, feet flat on the floor, right hand in the bell.

oboe.name: Oboe
oboe.posture_rhyme: Sit up straight, feet flat on the floor, instrument at a 45-degree angle.

baritone_euphonium.name: Baritone/Euphonium
baritone_euphonium.posture_rhyme: Sit up straight, feet flat on the floor, bring the mouthpiece to you.

tuba.name: Tuba
tuba.posture_rhyme: Sit on the edge of your seat, feet flat on the floor, rest the tuba comfortably on your lap.

recorder.name: Recorder
recorder.posture_rhyme: Sit up straight, left hand on top, right hand on bottom.

voice.name: Voice
voice.posture_rhyme: Stand up tall like a tree, feet shoulder width apart, shoulders relaxed.

piano.name: Piano
piano.posture_rhyme: Sit on the front half of the bench, feet flat on the floor, hands curved like holding a bubble.

percussion.name: Percussion
percussion.posture_rhyme: Stand evenly on both feet, grip the sticks loosely, keep wrists relaxed.
